entities.summary: Borna Nyaoke is a Kenyan physician and clinical researcher, who took over as head of mycetoma research in 2023 from her previous position as manager of clinical trials at Drugs for Neglected Diseases initiative/Global Antibiotic Research and Development Partnership (DNDi/GARDP). She previously worked as a clinical trial manager at the KAVI Institute of Clinical Research, based in the University of Nairobi.
